chunked.prompt: Fix chunks.py: chunked(items, size) returns a list of lists of at most size items, preserving order. Accept any iterable, do not mutate inputs; empty input returns []. size must be a positive integer (bool is invalid); otherwise raise ValueError.

merge_intervals.prompt: Fix intervals.py: merge_intervals(intervals) accepts pairs of numeric closed interval bounds, merges overlaps and touching endpoints, and returns sorted tuples. Empty input returns []. Reversed bounds raise ValueError. Do not mutate the input.

dotted_get.prompt: Refactor lookup.py: dotted_get(mapping, path, default=None) follows dot-separated dictionary keys. Return default if a component is missing or an intermediate value is not a dict. An empty path returns the original mapping. Existing falsey values and None must be preserved. Do not mutate mapping.

csv_summary.prompt: Repair the two-module sales API. parsing.py parse_rows(text) must parse CSV using headers item,quantity,price, including quoted commas, and return dictionaries with item:str, quantity:int, price:float. reporting.py totals(text) must use the parser and sum quantity*price per item into a dict. Header-only input yields {}. Preserve names; standard library only.

config_defaults.prompt: Fix settings.py and defaults.toml. defaults.toml must define timeout=30 and retries=2 at the top level. load_settings(path, overrides=None) parses that TOML file and returns its values with supplied overrides applied. Preserve zero/False values; never mutate overrides. Use only the standard library.

parse_bool_regression.prompt: Fix flags.py parse_bool(value): accept bool unchanged; for str strip whitespace and match case-insensitively true/yes/1/on or false/no/0/off; otherwise raise ValueError, including non-string non-bool values. Also add test_flags.py with standard-library unittest regression tests for false-like strings and invalid values. Do not change the public function name.
